d:
Bisleri ko bharat men dashkon se bharosemand paikejd drinking votar braind mana jata hai, lekin hal hi men kanpni ka ek sainpal khady suraksha mankon par khara nahin utra. FSSAI ne is mamle men bisleri ke khilaf muqadma chalane ki manzuri di hai.
Aakhir bisleri ke pani men kya mila? janch men bromet aur polisaiklik eromaitik haidrokarbans (PAH) ki maujudgi samne aane ka kya matlab hai? ye kemikal pani men kaise pahunchte hain aur sehat ke lie kitne khatarnak ho sakte hain?
Vahin, bisleri ne FSSAI ki janch par kya saphaee di hai? is vidiyo men janie pure vivad ki kahani.
Riport: shubh rana
